# Druxio — Full Documentation

> On-demand freelance expert marketplace with the lowest 5% platform fee. Post any task, get real-time quotes from verified freelancers in under 2 minutes.

## About

Druxio is a real-time freelance marketplace where clients post micro-tasks (€5–€50 budget) and receive competitive quotes from verified experts within minutes. The platform charges only a 5% fee — significantly lower than competitors like Fiverr (20%) or Upwork (10–20%). All payments are escrow-protected with automatic fund release after 48 hours if no dispute is raised.

**Website**: https://druxio.net  
**Support**: support@duxio.store  
**Social**: [@druxiostore](https://x.com/druxiostore) on X · [@druxio_store](https://instagram.com/druxio_store) on Instagram · [@druxio_store](https://tiktok.com/@druxio_store) on TikTok

---

## Platform Overview

### For Clients (Buyers)

- **Free to post**: Creating a request costs nothing
- **Budget range**: €5 to €50 per task
- **Quote system**: Receive up to 3 quotes from different experts
- **Escrow protection**: Payment is held securely until work is approved
- **Auto-release**: Funds automatically release to the expert 48 hours after delivery if no dispute is raised
- **Dispute resolution**: 24-hour turnaround on all disputes
- **AI matching**: Optional AI-powered expert matching based on request category and description

### For Experts (Sellers)

- **Free to join**: No subscription or listing fees
- **Earnings**: Keep 95% of every completed job
- **Real-time notifications**: Get alerted instantly when new jobs match your expertise
- **Flexible pricing**: Set your own prices within the client's budget range
- **Payouts**: Withdraw earnings via PayPal
- **Verification**: Badge system for identity, skill, and track record verification
- **Portfolio**: Showcase previous work with images and links

---

## Pricing Model

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Posting a request | Free |
| Platform fee | 5% (deducted from expert earnings) |
| Client cost | Exactly the quoted price — no hidden fees |
| Expert earnings | 95% of agreed price |
| Payment method | PayPal (escrow-protected) |
| Auto-release | 48 hours after delivery |
| Dispute window | Within 48 hours of delivery |

---

## How It Works — Step by Step

### Client Flow
1. **Post a request** — Describe what you need, select a category, set a budget (€5–€50)
2. **Receive quotes** — Up to 3 verified experts bid on your request with price and estimated time
3. **Accept a quote** — Choose the best expert; payment is captured and held in escrow
4. **Work gets done** — Communicate via built-in chat with file sharing
5. **Approve & release** — Review the delivery, approve it, or raise a dispute within 48h

### Expert Flow
1. **Create a profile** — Add skills, bio, hourly rate, and portfolio items
2. **Browse requests** — Filter by category; get real-time notifications for matching jobs
3. **Submit a quote** — Set your price and estimated delivery time with an optional message
4. **Deliver the work** — Complete the task and mark it as delivered
5. **Get paid** — Funds release after client approval or 48h auto-release; withdraw via PayPal

---

## Trust & Safety

- **Escrow payments**: All funds are held in escrow until work is approved
- **Verification badges**: Experts can earn identity, skill, and track record badges
- **Content moderation**: AI-powered content moderation on all submissions
- **User reporting**: Built-in reporting system for policy violations
- **Ban system**: Admins can ban users who violate terms of service
- **Dispute panel**: Structured negotiation → escalation → admin resolution flow

## Technical Details

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **Backend**: Lovable Cloud (Supabase-powered)
- **Authentication**: Email + Google OAuth
- **Payments**: PayPal (escrow model)
- **AI Features**: AI-powered expert matching, content moderation, request refinement, session summaries
- **Real-time**: Live presence indicators, instant notifications, real-time chat
